- Alias convention: use the pattern acme-plan-{env}-{index} for plan aliases (e.g., acme-plan-staging-01). Avoid spaces; lowercase only.
- ARM checksum: see attached arm-deploy-checksum.txt — we compute a SHA256 over the top-level manifest and the ARM template. If your local checksum matches, the ingestion step usually proceeds.

John / Olga — quick technical note after I reviewed the SPN-proof.pdf and manifest:

- The SPN was created under subscription id 0a1b2c-xxxx which is the Acme production subscription. For staging we require either a staging SPN in the publisher staging subscription or a signed cross-tenant assertion accompanied by audit logs showing the SPN creation time and role assignments. Microsoft prefers the former.
- For the SKU GUID discrepancy: the portal auto-generates plan GUIDs when you create plans directly in the Offer UI. If you built the manifest offline and imported it, the portal may have re-mapped those when the offer was created. The fastest fix is to export the current Offer manifest from the portal, replace your plan IDs with those exported values, and then re-run the ingestion.

I attached a small helper script we use internally (ARM template snippet and validation commands) to compute the package checksum and validate plan alias mapping. If you want, I can schedule 30 minutes tomorrow to run it with your engineering lead.
